params.notes: 1 stone is taken from the general supply and set on whichever of the Forest / Clay Pit pair was not used

effects.notes: Each time the owner uses the Forest or Clay Pit accumulation space, they may move 1 stone from the general supply onto the other of the two spaces; only when they do so may they immediately place one more of their unplaced people. The two steps are chained: skipping the stone also skips the extra placement.
